choices.why: Its distressed brown leather is exactly the aged-leather look requested, and at 218 cm it anchors the open loft space.
A warm planked solid-wood top in a black metal frame is the most clearly industrial table and suits the long sofa.
In the photo it is a tall shelf with slim black metal posts and warm wood trays, the requested black metal and wood mix, though its listed 43 cm height should be checked against the photo.
This black metal arm lamp with a workshop shade and brass details is classic industrial and works well beside the sofa.
A large 292x231 jute rug in a brown and black herringbone gives earthy texture and is big enough to sit under both the sofa and the table.
The cushions' brown, black, grey and beige checks tie together the leather, the metal and the rug.
The dark, aged bronze faceted metal pot fits the dark-metal brief better than the light or gold options, although none of the candidates looks big enough for a truly large plant.

answer.why: Aged leather, solid wood and black metal repeat across every piece and echo the exposed beams and light parquet, giving a warm industrial loft. The earth-tone jute rug pulls it all together, with nothing in bright white.
